review_comments: The old approach looks more correct for a test helper.
Get the CR here, remove the fake default CR above and initialize it as `nil`.
Do we really need a custom backoff here?

In all recent flakes I see following error 
```shell
util.go:1042: Failed to create CR: client rate limiter Wait returned an error: context deadline exceeded
```
All the error says is that the context got canceled meaning it timed out.  Retrying won't help because the context is already cancelled so all retries will fail.
